cameraControl.finding: Official static-camera adapter targets the older LTX-2 19B base. Compatibility with the current 22B 2.5 transformer has not been established here.
cameraControl.decision: Do not silently load an adapter for a different base model. First review the revised tripod reference and explicit locked-camera prompt.

detailRefinement.finding: Official 2.5 distilled video-to-video refinement adapter uses frame-aligned conditioning, tiled fusion and an optional spatially aligned identity reference. It is not trained for audio generation.
detailRefinement.decision: Potential subsequent experiment if the native high-resolution take still loses eye texture. Requires a separately verified workflow and local resource qualification; do not describe it as an installed or tested fix.
